takes place on multiple islands, which are split into islands with a blue flora and islands with a pink flora. Some islands are connected by wooden bridges. On the islands, multiple trees, bushes and rocks can be found. Lily pads can be seen, with glowing pink flowers. On one island, a giant tree can be found. This tree has a large metal platform, which can be accessed through a rope. On another island, a collapsed lighthouse can be found. On one of the main islands, there is a small stone statue with a humanoid that holds a sword.
The paths start at caves and end at a building, which appears to be an observatory. These paths merge near the middle of the map, near the stone statue.
